verdict.rationale: Lever has a documented public developer API covering applications (list, list deleted, create), audit events, webhooks with event payloads and signing, and OAuth. Nothing shows the API matches the UI. Many UI-highlighted capabilities have no evidenced API equivalent: the career site builder, analytics dashboards, Automation Hub rules, nurture campaigns, AI features and onboarding forms. Missing for 10: any explicit API/UI parity statement, documented endpoints for configuration, career-site, reporting/dashboard, automation and AI features, and independent or hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
